orders._comment: Order board. Rewards = sum(item sell * qty) * coinMult, XP = sum(qty * itemXp) where itemXp ~ sell/xpDivisor.

truck._comment: Truck depot: crates of items. Each crate pays out on fill; finishing all crates grants a bonus and a mystery crate.

merchant._comment: Travelling merchant visits for visitSec every cycleSec. Stock is seeded by the visit number.

barn._comment: Selling straight from the barn pays this fraction of the item value (stall and orders pay more).

charm._comment: Every 'step' charm points gives the listed bonus, capped at max.

speedup._comment: Gem cost to finish any timer immediately = max(minGems, ceil(minutesLeft * gemsPerMinute)).

_qualityComment: 1.8 star quality: base chance of a silver or gold item from harvests, animals, fishing and workshops (src/systems/Quality.ts).

social._comment: Friends and gifts. Daily limits keep gifting cozy: gifts and gift codes both count. Coins per gift and per day are capped; items per gift count every unit.

botGift._comment: Practice mode only: at most once a day a demo neighbour sends a small thank-you gift.

help._comment: 1.8 Ask a friend (src/systems/Help.ts). maxOpen, maxQty, sameItemHours, asksPerDay, expireHours and fillsPerDay match the server (supabase/schema.sql, 1.8 help). Helpers get rewardMult x the barn value in coins (rewardMin..rewardMax) for rewardedPerDay sends a day. After hazelAfterMin an unfilled request can be finished by Hazel at the market's fair price x hazelMarkup. Auto-help keeps at least reserveDefault of each item. practice = demo neighbours in practice mode.

practice._comment: Demo neighbours fill part of each request after fillAfterSec, the rest a little later; each demo friend asks for one thing a day.

market._comment: Shared market between players. Prices are totals for the stack, clamped to minPriceMult..maxPriceMult x (item sell value x qty). slotsByLevel = [level, open listings]. practiceBuy = how the demo neighbours of practice mode buy your goods; practiceSellMinMult = demo neighbour goods never cost less than this x barn value, so they cannot be flipped for free coins.
